## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the adult female character from <Picture 1>: a woman with a long oval face, dark purple hair, large curled ivory horns, black feathered wings, a white satin costume with gold trim, and long white gloves. Preserve her elegant, aloof, magnetic presence, signature finger-near-lips gesture, horns, wings, hair, and costume.

<Subject 2> is the adult female character from <Picture 2>: a woman with a soft round face, short blue-gray bobbed hair, bangs covering one eye, a silver floral headband, a black-and-white maid dress, and a bouquet of white lilies. Preserve her lively expression, hairstyle, maid costume, bouquet, and playful energy.

<Subject 3> is the grand aristocratic salon from <Picture 3>: a large white-and-gold palace interior with ornate columns, crystal chandeliers, tall arched windows, dark teal curtains with gold trim, marble floors, classical furniture, paintings, and warm daylight. Preserve this architectural atmosphere and color palette.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a 12-second single-take live-action fantasy scene in <Subject 3>. <Subject 1> enters from the left and performs her signature pose. The camera rapidly zooms into her charming close-up and smoothly returns. <Subject 2> then runs in from the opposite side, pretends to bump into <Subject 1>, raises the bouquet as an offering, and is coldly dismissed. <Subject 1> gives her an aloof glance and visibly leaves. The camera then rapidly zooms into <Subject 2>, who gives a playful one-eye wink. No dialogue and no background music.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - her facial identity, purple hair, ivory horns, black wings, white-and-gold costume, signature pose, and aloof expression are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - her facial identity, blue-gray bob, maid costume, bouquet, playful energy, and final wink are retained.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the white-and-gold palace architecture, chandeliers, marble floor, teal curtains, gilded details, and warm daylight are retained.

detailed_description:
The target video is photographed as realistic live-action fantasy cinema with natural human skin, practical costumes, believable feathers, real fabric fibers, realistic hair movement, and polished 35mm film texture. Use fine organic grain, soft highlight halation, warm natural skin tones, gentle highlight roll-off, and cinematic exposure. Avoid glossy CGI, plastic skin, game-render aesthetics, excessive sharpening, digital noise, artificial face morphing, hard cuts, jump transitions, and sudden camera resets.

[Shot 1] This is one continuous 12-second take with no cuts, dissolves, teleportation, or disappearing characters. The scene takes place inside <Subject 3>. The camera begins in an elegant medium shot that establishes the palace interior while keeping the characters prominent. Use a realistic 50mm-equivalent lens, natural depth of field, and smooth physical camera movement.

From 00:00.000 to 00:00.800, the palace salon is empty. Warm daylight enters through the tall windows, chandeliers glint softly, and the polished marble floor reflects the architecture.

From 00:00.800 to 00:02.200, <Subject 1> enters visibly from the left side of the frame. Her black wing, white glove, and ivory horns appear first. She walks slowly and confidently toward the center, then stops in her signature pose: one gloved fingertip near her lips, head slightly tilted, one wing subtly opened, and a calm magnetic gaze directed toward the camera.

From 00:02.200 to 00:03.500, the camera performs a rapid but smooth optical zoom into a glamorous close-up of <Subject 1>. Emphasize her eyes, ivory horns, purple hair, white glove, satin texture, and faint confident smile. The zoom must be photographic and continuous, without digital warping or a sudden scale jump.

From 00:03.500 to 00:04.200, the camera smoothly zooms back to the original medium framing. <Subject 1> remains poised in the center.

At 00:04.200, <Subject 2> runs into the frame from the right side with the bouquet held in front of her. From 00:04.500 to 00:05.600, she deliberately pretends to lose her balance and lightly bumps shoulder-to-shoulder into <Subject 1>. The bump is clearly playful and staged, with no fall, injury, or violent impact. The bouquet, hair, wing, and costumes react naturally to the contact.

From 00:05.600 to 00:06.800, <Subject 2> quickly straightens, raises the bouquet with both hands, and offers the lilies toward <Subject 1> with an innocent, hopeful smile. <Subject 1> does not accept the bouquet.

From 00:06.800 to 00:07.700, the camera makes a brief controlled handheld jolt and smoothly pans toward <Subject 1>. She gives <Subject 2> one cold, disdainful side glance: slightly narrowed eyes, lifted chin, neutral lips, and restrained impatience. She does not speak.

From 00:07.700 to 00:09.300, <Subject 1> turns away and walks visibly toward the left edge of the frame. The camera follows her with a gentle continuous pan, keeping her body, wings, hair, gloves, and costume visible until she completely exits. Do not make her disappear, dissolve, teleport, or vanish behind an invisible transition.

From 00:09.300 to 00:10.200, the camera smoothly returns to <Subject 2>, who remains in the palace holding the bouquet close to her chest. From 00:10.200 to 00:11.600, the camera performs a fast variable-speed optical zoom toward <Subject 2>: quick acceleration, smooth deceleration, and a stable final close-up.

From 00:11.600 to 00:12.000, <Subject 2> looks directly into the lens, tilts her head slightly, smiles mischievously, and gives one clear playful wink with a single eye while keeping the other eye open. Hold the final close-up without cutting.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet palace room tone, soft footsteps, realistic shoe contact, fabric movement, feather rustle, bouquet stems, subtle costume sounds, gentle camera handling, and natural room reverberation. No dialogue and no singing.
